facts.fact: Adwave's own page says the Wavemaker free plan gives 75 credits, enough for a first video, at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: The free tier gives you 75 credits, enough for a first video, at 480p with a watermark.

facts.fact: Adwave states that most Wavemaker videos come back in two to five minutes (vendor claim).
facts.quote: Most videos come back in two to five minutes.

facts.fact: Adwave says its TV bridge can run a Wavemaker video as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks through Adwave, starting from $50 (vendor claim).
facts.quote: it can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks through Adwave, starting from $50

facts.fact: Adwave says Wavemaker includes a 13-tool MCP server alongside a REST video API (vendor claim).
Adwave says Wavemaker credit packs never expire.
facts.quote: Credit packs are available, and they never expire.

facts.fact: Adwave says Wavemaker paid tiers add up to 1080p resolution, then up to 4K, plus no-watermark exports.
facts.quote: Paid tiers add more monthly credits, higher resolution (up to 1080p, then up to 4K), no watermark

facts.fact: The Adwave VEED alternatives article was published on 2026-07-14.
Adwave's page states that Wavemaker offers a free plan with 75 credits at 480p resolution.
facts.quote: Wavemaker offers a free plan with 75 credits (enough for a first video) at 480p

facts.fact: Adwave's page says Pictory has no free-forever tier historically and is trial-based, with monthly plans scaling by video minutes and features.
facts.quote: No free-forever tier historically (trial-based), then monthly plans scaling by video minutes and features.

facts.fact: Adwave's page describes VEED's free plan as limited and watermarked.
Adwave's page reports criticism that InVideo's credits do not roll over and that its free access is limited, and advises checking current terms.
facts.quote: InVideo's pricing and credit model have drawn criticism (limited "free" access, credits that don't roll over)

facts.fact: Adwave's page says Fliki has a limited free tier, and that its subscriptions use credit or minute limits.
facts.quote: Fliki has a limited free tier; InVideo's free access is more restricted than the name suggests.

facts.fact: Wavemaker (per its vendor, Adwave) can take a pasted URL, scrape the site's brand colors, imagery, and messaging into a creative brief, and generate a video from it.
facts.quote: Paste a URL and it scrapes the site's brand colors, imagery, and messaging into a creative brief, then generates a video from that.

facts.fact: Wavemaker, according to its vendor, offers a REST video API and a 13-tool MCP server.
facts.quote: Wavemaker is built for this, with a REST video API and a 13-tool MCP server that works in Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, and other MCP clients.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's MCP server works in Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, and other MCP clients, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: a 13-tool MCP server that works in Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, and other MCP clients

facts.fact: According to Adwave, a finished Wavemaker video can run as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks through Adwave, starting from $50.
facts.quote: A finished Wavemaker video can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks through Adwave, starting from $50
